identity: Neutral gas-phase nitric oxide NO, CAS 10102-43-9, X 2Pi ground electronic state with spin-orbit and Lambda-doubling structure; not NO+, NO- or the NO2/N2O molecular species.
recommendation: Prepare an ATcT energy-only candidate on the literal inherited fit, preserving its thermal function and fit residual. This is a smaller priority than NH2. A wholesale thermal replacement is not needed to correct the identified energy discrepancy: normalized XABC state sums closely reproduce NASA and the evaluated JANAF/NASA thermal difference is small over this range.
science: ATcT 1.228 reduces balanced atomization energy by 1.024 kJ/mol relative to JANAF, whereas NASA already lies close to the modern energy. The diagnostic energy-only ratio is 0.921 at 1500 K and 0.970 at 4000 K. This is a physical D0 difference, not replacement of the fitted 1/T intercept. The direct XABC calculation supplies modern thermal evidence in addition to source-to-source agreement.
modern: Qu et al. (2021) XABC and Gamache et al. (2024) were read in full. XABC supplies 30811 states through J=184.5; the downloaded file contains 21688 X-state levels, whereas the paper prose prints 21668 (the other manifold counts agree). The compact packet retains only energy, total weight, J and electronic label. Direct state moments reproduce the published partition nodes within 0.60 ppm; the small source/constants residual is retained rather than asserted to be exactly zero. The 2024 work uses these states and explicitly notes levels above the dissociation threshold, as well as isotope and entropy conventions. Its printed absolute natural-sample entropy should not be copied directly into a spin-free chemistry model: this review instead divides the ExoMol weights by the explicit nuclear-spin product 3 once, preserving both resolved spin-orbit ladders and Lambda components. No additional electronic degeneracy is multiplied in.
importance: NO is relevant to nitrogen chemistry and UV nightglow on Venus and Mars as discussed by XABC. These radiative/non-LTE applications are not validated by the hot hydrogen-rich equilibrium inventory.
conventions: For 14N16O, nuclear-spin product=3 and rotational symmetry number=1. Total weights are exactly 3(2J+1); resolved electronic/fine-structure components already occur as distinct states. The lowest level is zero, no extra ZPE is added, and natural-mass translation is a declared principal-isotope proxy. A separate isotope-mass ratio is a sensitivity, not a balanced isotope reaction. All distributed states are used diagnostically; above-D0 and highest-J fractions do not prove missing-state completeness.
followup: Build a retained-thermal ATcT energy candidate and evaluate it on the current network before any adoption. If a later full XABC thermal representation is desired, validate continuous derivatives, bound/resonance policy, all isotope/spin conventions and compare against the 2024 thermodynamic tables.
